reviews.title: Great until they try to force you to pay for it
reviews.text: This app was great, simple and easy to use. You can label multiple different counters. But now, every time you open the app (or unlock your phone) it tries to get you to pay for an ad free version of the app… for $12.99. That is WILDLY expensive for an app that literally only has banner ads. The only annoying pop up to remove is the constant ‘premium’ price alerts. And I’m not paying $13 to shut them up. Time to find a different app.
